Home.heroTitle: Freight and parcels, <accent>priced before you commit</accent>
Home.heroSubtitle: Get a complete cost breakdown in seconds. Freight, fuel, insurance, customs, and handling each appear on their own line. Then follow your shipment from pickup to delivery with updates that tell you what happens next.
Home.svcAirDesc: For time-critical cargo. Priority routing on international lanes, with clearance handled alongside the booking.
Home.svcSeaDesc: The economical choice above roughly 500 kg. Slower than air, substantially cheaper per kilogram on volume.
Home.svcRoadDesc: Domestic and regional movement, plus the first and last mile that connects to every air and ocean route.
Home.svcWarehouseDesc: Secure storage between legs, with inventory handling for businesses shipping repeatedly on the same lanes.
Home.featPricingDesc: Freight, fuel, insurance, handling, customs, and tax are itemised at quote time. No figure appears on your invoice that you have not already seen.
Home.featTrackingDesc: Each milestone states what happened, where, and what comes next, so you are never left interpreting a status code on your own.
Home.featInsuranceDesc: Coverage is calculated from your declared value rather than sold as a flat add-on, so you pay in proportion to what is actually at risk.
Home.featSupportDesc: Live chat and a ticket system with full shipment history attached, so you are not repeating your tracking number to every new agent.
Home.whySub: Most logistics providers promise reliability. Here is what that means in practice on this platform.
Home.pricingTitle: Every line of your invoice, before you book
Home.pricingP1: Hidden fees are the most common complaint in freight, and they usually arrive after the cargo is already moving, when refusing is no longer realistic.
Home.pricingP2: We calculate the full breakdown at quote time and show it to you in full. Base freight reflects your route, weight, and mode. Fuel and insurance are percentages you can see. Customs appears only where the route requires it.
Home.pricingB1: Volumetric weight flagged whenever it applies to your package
Home.pricingB2: Currency shown in your local denomination, converted at quote time
Home.pricingB3: The approved total is the invoiced total, with nothing added later
Home.sampleNote: Illustrative figures. Your quote is calculated from your actual route, weight, dimensions, and declared value.
Home.modesSub: Speed and cost pull against each other. Here is when each mode is the right call. We select it automatically from your shipment details, and explain why.
Home.howSub: Four stages. You are told what is required at each one before you reach it.
Home.how1Text: Enter route, weight, dimensions, and declared value. The full itemised cost returns in seconds.
Home.how2Text: Review the breakdown, confirm pickup details, and pay by bank transfer, PayPal, or crypto.
Home.how3Text: Each milestone records what happened, where, and when, plus the next expected step.
Home.how4Text: Confirmation is logged with the full status history retained for your records.
Home.coverageP1: International shipping fails at the handoffs: between carriers, at borders, on the last mile. We work through vetted regional partners so each leg is handled by people who operate that lane routinely.
Home.coverageP2: Your tracking timeline stays continuous across every handoff, so a change of carrier never means a gap in visibility.
Home.coverageB1: Status updates written in plain language, not carrier codes
Home.coverageB2: Optional insurance and secure handling for sensitive cargo
Home.coverageB3: Delivery estimates given as a date range, not a single optimistic day
Home.coverageNote: Coverage varies by cargo type and service level. Enter your route on the quote page to confirm availability.
Home.trustSub: Three areas where shipments most often go wrong, and what we do about each.
Home.trust1Text: Cargo is scanned at each transfer point, so if something is delayed or misrouted we can identify exactly where it happened rather than guessing.
Home.trust2Text: Premiums are calculated from your declared value. Accurate declaration matters, because it determines both your premium and your maximum recovery.
Home.trust3Text: Incomplete paperwork causes more delays than any other factor. We tell you what each destination requires before dispatch, not after a shipment is held.
Home.whoSub: The platform handles a single parcel and a recurring freight programme on the same rails.
Home.who1Text: Sending personal effects, gifts, or documents across borders. No account minimums and no contracts. Quote, pay, and ship.
Home.who2Text: Shipping orders to international customers. Consistent tracking your buyers can follow themselves, plus warehousing between restocks.
Home.who3Text: Moving inventory, equipment, or high-value cargo on repeat lanes. Volume pricing and insurance sized to what you are actually moving.
Home.readyP1: Start with a quote. It costs nothing, takes about a minute, and shows you the complete cost before you commit to anything.
Home.readyP2: If the numbers do not work for you, you have lost a minute. If they do, your shipment is booked and tracking from the same page.
Home.faqSub: The things customers actually ask before their first shipment.
Home.faq1q: How is my shipping cost calculated?
Home.faq1a:
Your quote is built from six components: base freight, a fuel surcharge, insurance on your declared value, a handling fee, customs clearance where the route requires it, and any applicable tax.

Each line is shown separately before you book, so you can see exactly what you are paying for rather than a single unexplained total.

Nothing is added later. The figure you approve is the figure on your invoice.
Home.faq2q: Why is my quote higher than the weight I entered suggests?
Home.faq2a:
Carriers charge on whichever is greater: the actual weight of your package, or its volumetric weight, which is length × width × height in centimetres divided by 5000.

A large, light package occupies space that cannot be sold to anyone else, so it is priced on the space it takes rather than what it weighs.

When volumetric weight applies to your shipment, we say so on the quote and show both figures, so the higher price is never a surprise.
Home.faq3q: How do I track my shipment?
Home.faq3a:
Enter your tracking number on the Track page. You will see a timeline of every stage the shipment has passed through, each with a timestamp and location.

Every entry states what happened and what happens next, rather than leaving you to interpret a status label.

If a shipment is held at customs, the timeline says why and what is required to release it.
Home.faq4a:
Yes, on routes that require it. Clearance is priced into your quote rather than billed as an unexpected charge later.

We tell you which documents are needed before dispatch, because incomplete paperwork is the single most common cause of delay in international shipping.

If additional documentation becomes necessary in transit, you will be contacted directly rather than left to discover it from a stalled tracking page.
Home.faq5a:
Insurance is calculated from the declared value you enter at quote time and appears as its own line on your invoice.

Declaring an accurate value matters. Under-declaring reduces your premium but caps what can be recovered if something goes wrong.

For high-value or fragile cargo, contact support before booking and we will advise on the right level of cover.
Home.faq6a:
Bank transfer, PayPal, and major cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, USDT, and Ethereum. Available methods are shown on your invoice.

Every invoice carries a unique payment reference. Include it with your transfer so we can match your payment without delay.

After paying, upload your receipt from the payment page. We verify it and confirm by email, and your shipment status updates automatically.

Contact.title: Contact us
Contact.subtitle: Questions about a shipment, an invoice, or working with us? Send a message and we will get back to you.
Contact.formSubtitle: We reply to every message, usually within one business day.

Contact.faqSubtitle: Quick answers to the things people ask most.
Contact.faq1Q: How do I track my shipment?
Contact.faq1A: Use the tracking number from your confirmation email on our <track>tracking page</track>. You do not need an account to see where a shipment is.
Contact.faq2Q: Which countries do you ship to?
Contact.faq2A: We handle international shipping worldwide, and domestic shipping within a growing list of countries. The quote page shows what is available for your route.
Contact.faq3Q: How do I get a shipping quote?
Contact.faq3A: Enter your origin, destination and package details on the <quote>quote page</quote> for an instant price. No account needed.
Contact.faq4Q: What if my package arrives damaged?
Contact.faq4A: Contact us at <email></email> with your tracking number and photographs of the damage, and we will start a claim for you.

About.title: About {company}
About.subtitle: We move parcels and freight across borders and within them, using our own warehouses, our own vehicles and pricing built for each market we serve.
About.storyPara1: We have been in freight since {year}. What began as a regional operation now handles international air and sea shipments alongside domestic road delivery, and we still run our own warehouses and vehicles rather than reselling someone else's capacity.
About.storyPara2: That matters more than it sounds. When a shipment sits in a warehouse, it is our warehouse. When it moves by road, it is our driver. We are accountable for what happens to your goods rather than passing you between carriers when something needs explaining.
About.storyPara3: The platform grew out of the same idea. Customers kept asking the same questions, where is my shipment, what will this cost, why is the invoice this amount. So we built somewhere they could see the answers themselves, in their own language, without waiting for someone to reply.
About.diffSubtitle: Most of what makes shipping frustrating comes down to not knowing. We have spent our effort on the parts customers actually feel.
About.diff1Desc: We handle storage and road delivery ourselves. That means one company answering for your shipment rather than a chain of subcontractors pointing at each other.
About.diff2Desc: A domestic delivery in Lagos does not cost what one in Frankfurt costs, so we do not charge as though it does. Every country we serve has its own rate card built on local conditions.
About.diff3Desc: Tracking, invoices, quotes and notifications all appear in your language, not just the marketing pages. Customers should not have to read English to find out where their shipment is.
About.diff4Desc: Get a full cost breakdown before you commit to anything. No sign up, no sales call, no waiting for someone to email you a figure.
About.principlesSubtitle: Three things we hold ourselves to, written plainly enough that you can tell when we fall short.
About.missionDesc: Move goods reliably between and within countries, and make the whole process visible to the people paying for it.
About.visionDesc: A logistics service where the price is clear before you book, the location is clear while it moves, and the invoice holds no surprises.
About.valuesDesc: Say what a shipment will cost and charge that. Say where it is and be right. When something goes wrong, tell the customer before they have to ask.
About.howSubtitle: Three steps, and you can do the first without talking to anyone.
About.step1Desc: Enter the route and package details for a full breakdown of what it will cost, including fuel, handling, insurance and customs where they apply.
About.step2Desc: Create an account, confirm the details and we collect. You get a tracking number and an invoice straight away.
About.step3Desc: Watch each stage as it happens, from collection to delivery. Notifications reach you by email and in your dashboard, in your own language.
About.ctaTitle: See what your shipment would cost
About.ctaBody: Get a full price breakdown in under a minute. No account, no obligation.
Services.title: What we ship, and how
Services.subtitle: Air, sea and road freight, with customs handling, warehousing and tracking built into every shipment rather than sold as extras.
Services.coreSubtitle: Three ways to move freight. The quote page picks the right one for your route, weight and package type, and shows what each would cost.
Services.airDesc: The fastest option for international shipments, suited to goods where timing matters more than cost per kilogram.
Services.airF3: Volumetric weight applied fairly, never twice
Services.seaDesc: The economical choice for heavy or bulky international freight, where a longer transit is worth the saving.
Services.seaF3: Rates that fall as weight rises
Services.seaF4: Warehousing at both ends where needed
Services.roadDesc: Domestic delivery within a country, run on our own vehicles rather than handed to a subcontractor.
Services.roadF2: Door to door collection and delivery
Services.roadF3: Pricing set for each country we serve
Services.roadF4: Our drivers, our vehicles, our responsibility
Services.speedNote: Transit times are working days and depend on distance, service level and customs. The quote page gives an estimated range for your specific route before you book anything.
Services.credFiataDesc: We are a member of FIATA, the international federation of freight forwarding associations, and work to its standards.
Services.credLiabilityDesc: We carry cargo liability insurance on the freight we move. Cover limits are available <link>on request</link>.
Services.credFleetDesc: Our storage and road delivery run on our own vehicles and facilities, so one company answers for your shipment.
Services.includedSubtitle: These are not add-ons. They come with the service, and they are already in the price you are quoted.
Services.customsDesc: We prepare and file the documentation for international shipments. Where a clearance fee applies, it appears on your quote before you book, not as a surprise later.
Services.warehousingDesc: Your goods pass through our own facilities rather than a rented shelf somewhere. Where a shipment needs to wait, it waits somewhere we control.
Services.insuranceDesc: Cover is calculated from the value you declare and shown as its own line on the quote, so you can see exactly what it costs.
Services.trackingDesc: Anyone with the tracking number can see where a shipment is, including the person receiving it. No sign up, no waiting for an update by email.
Services.invoicingDesc: An itemised invoice is generated when you book and updated as the shipment moves. Every charge is broken out rather than rolled into one figure.
Services.languageDesc: Quotes, tracking, invoices and notifications all appear in your language. Your receiver sees theirs, even if it is different from yours.
Services.pricingTitle: How the price is worked out
Services.pricingPara1: Freight pricing is usually opaque, which is why so many quotes arrive as a single number with no explanation. We show the whole calculation instead.
Services.pricingPara2: Rates are set for each country rather than applied globally, because a domestic delivery costs a different amount in each market. What you see on the quote page is what the invoice will say.
Services.breakdown1: Base freight, calculated from distance, weight and route
Services.breakdown2: Fuel surcharge, as a percentage you can see
Services.breakdown3: Insurance, based on the value you declare
Services.breakdown4: Handling and customs clearance where they apply
Services.breakdown5: The total, in your own currency
Services.breakdownNote: Quotes hold for seven days. The final charge only changes if the package is remeasured at collection and differs from what was entered.
Services.ctaTitle: Find out what your shipment costs
Services.ctaBody: A full breakdown in under a minute. No account, no sales call, no obligation.
